_rule: Structure ratchet for web/js and web/custom.js, checked by hub/web-structure-web.test.ts and frozen by .githooks/pre-push. A fix lowers the number in the same commit; never raise one.

reasons.currentAssign 05-command-palette.js: go() is the one navigation entry and the only place current changes.
reasons.overlaySites overlay:asPaneOpen: An app's settings on a wide monitoring screen stand in the right column of the app frame (#as-pane) with the item's list still at the left: a pane of the screen, not a window, with no scrim, nothing modal and no fade. The same settings on a phone are fsOpen (asScreen). ovOpen only makes the pane one back step. Pinned by hub/settings-header-web.test.ts and hub/monitoring-home-frame-web.test.ts.
reasons.overlaySites overlay:prGo: Another computer opened inside the installed app is that computer's whole page in a full-screen iframe (.pr-frame, which keeps the safe areas), not a window of this app: no card, title, scrim or focus trap of ours, the page inside draws its own. ovOpen makes the back gesture close it. Pinned by hub/peers-web.test.ts.
reasons.overlaySites overlay:prOpen: The computer switcher (.ds-sheet.pr-sheet) is a part of its own: on a wide screen a popover under the sidebar's brand row with no scrim, on a phone a bottom sheet that leaves the tab bar free so the home tab pressed again closes it. fsOpen covers the whole screen and has no anchor. Pinned by hub/overlay-fullscreen-web.test.ts (it stays the bottom sheet, not the full-screen frame).
reasons.overlaySites overlay:trPaneOpen: Fast triage on a wide monitoring screen stands in the right column in place of the reply queue (.rq-pane.tr-pane, drawn by the screen as RQ.sheet) with the list still at the left: a pane of the screen, not a window. On a phone it is fsOpen (tqOpen). ovOpen only makes the pane one back step. Pinned by hub/surface-geometry-web.test.ts.
reasons.overlaySites rawdialog:kkViewer: KakaoTalk's photo and video viewer is the same lightbox (dialog.lbox.kk-vwd, docs/ui-spec.md lightbox): a media stage with previous and next, not a window.
reasons.overlaySites rawdialog:lightboxAt: The lightbox (dialog.lbox, docs/ui-spec.md lightbox) is a media stage of its own, not a window: a fitted picture, pinch and double-tap zoom, arrows and swipe between pictures. Pinned by hub/composer-image-web.test.ts and hub/ask-sheet-images-web.test.ts.
reasons.rawNet 01-forbidden-pair.js: window.fetch wrapper: every response, api() or raw, passes the pairing gate (403 with X-Dotz-Pair) first.
reasons.rawNet 11-mailbody.js: the mail's stored HTML body (text, not JSON, which api() would turn into null) and inline image blobs read through a cache-friendly fetch, not JSON calls.
reasons.rawNet 15-attachments.js: file bodies and HEAD probes of attachments, not JSON calls.
reasons.rawNet 15-upload.js: XMLHttpRequest for upload progress, which fetch cannot report.
reasons.rawNet 17-state-refresh.js: keepalive input-diagnostics beacon; beacons must not mark the page alive, so they stay outside api().
reasons.rawNet 23-installable-app-web.js: keepalive push tap and presence beacons; beacons must not mark the page alive, so they stay outside api().
reasons.rawNet 30-canvas.js: canvas file body, not a JSON call.
reasons.rawNet 31-conversations.js: keepalive viewing beacon on unload; beacons must not mark the page alive, so they stay outside api().
reasons.rawNet 34-input-diag.js: input-diagnostics report that may go out as a keepalive beacon on page hide.
reasons.rawNet 36-shell.js: streamed terminal output read chunk by chunk with an abort signal.
reasons.rawNet 99-boot.js: the live event stream (EventSource), not a JSON call.
